exists.why: A grant's starting value is the state's power catalog (data/research/powers-catalog/catalog.json, read by policyAuthority), not a law row; the starting state of the town law it enables is graded on that law.

knowing.why: Nobody hears of a grant until a town uses it; the news prints the town law it enables, graded as that law's knowing link.

repeal.why: A grant reaches no one, so repealing it stops nothing of its own; the state's bill that withdraws it is the same bill route as any law (state legislature, both chambers, the governor), run in Middlebury, Vermont (seed ceeca1aba80bfe3ccdb5aa0e04eb3f7c409b851c0179c93da168f5771a9a4058): the grants took effect on July 1, 2025 and a second bill unwound them (docs/reports/dev-tests/2026-11-08.md). What a town stops doing is graded on the town law.
